description: Biz, uzay ve teknolojiye ilgi duyan, araştırmayı ve yeni fikirler üretmeyi seven bir ortaokul ekibiz. Mars'ta yaşamı konu alan eğitici bir oyun geliştiriyoruz. Ekibimize katılacak arkadaşlarımızın meraklı, yaratıcı, sorumluluk sahibi ve takım çalışmasına yatkın olmasını istiyoruz. Deneyimden çok öğrenmeye ve birlikte üretmeye açık olmalarını önemsiyoruz.
summary:
**Project Summary – MARS: Survival Beyond Earth**

MARS: Survival Beyond Earth is an interactive simulation designed to explore the challenges of establishing sustainable human life on Mars. The project places players in charge of a Martian research base, where they must manage limited resources such as water, oxygen, energy, and food while maintaining suitable living conditions. Through interactive missions, agricultural production, environmental monitoring, and resource management, users experience the complex decisions required to sustain a human settlement beyond Earth. The simulation also introduces unexpected challenges that require players to develop effective solutions and balance competing needs. By combining space exploration, agricultural sustainability, and resource optimization, our project transforms complex scientific concepts into an accessible educational experience. It aims to raise awareness of the challenges of future Mars missions and demonstrate why efficient resource management and sustainable systems are essential for long-term human exploration of space.
details:
Detailed Project Description – MARS: Survival Beyond Earth

MARS: Survival Beyond Earth is an interactive educational simulation that explores the challenges of establishing and maintaining a sustainable human settlement on Mars. Our project transforms the complex idea of living on another planet into an interactive experience where users make decisions, manage resources, and observe the consequences of their choices.

The simulation places users in control of a Martian research base for a mission lasting 30 Martian days (sols). Its main objective is to maintain the base by balancing essential resources, including water, oxygen, energy, and food. Users can explore agricultural production, monitor plant growth, manage available resources, and respond to changing environmental conditions and unexpected challenges.

The agricultural system highlights the importance of growing food in an environment where resources are limited. The resource management system demonstrates how decisions about water, energy, and oxygen can affect the sustainability of the entire settlement. Through interactive tasks and mission objectives, users learn that survival on Mars requires planning, efficient resource use, and the coordination of different life-support systems.

Our project was developed as a browser-based application using HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript. These technologies allow the simulation to run through a web browser without requiring a separate installation. We used a text editor for writing and editing the code, a web browser for testing, and Netlify to publish the application online.

The creative aspect of our project is the combination of space exploration, agricultural sustainability, resource management, and interactive learning in one simulation. Instead of simply presenting information about Mars, we allow users to experience the challenges through their own decisions.

Our intended impact is to encourage curiosity about planetary science, sustainable agriculture, and future human space exploration. We also aim to make complex scientific topics more understandable and engaging, especially for students.

The simulation uses simplified educational values for gameplay. These values are not intended to represent exact engineering predictions or real-time measurements of Mars.
